paragraphs: Posted by Lily. Tom's class and the Explorers each took a day trip this term. The first text is by Tom, and the second text is by me. Read both texts, and find the same facts and the different facts.

On Friday, Teacher Nick took my class on a train to a small town by the sea. Each pupil wore a name card around the neck as identification. We also had a small bag, because Teacher Nick said, "Luggage must be light." The train left the station early, at seven o'clock, and the ride took two hours. We sang songs and played word games on the train. I sat next to Ben. Ben had the window seat.

At noon, a thunderstorm began, so we ran to a small restaurant near the beach. A waitress gave each of us a plate of rice fried in oil with chicken. The food was hot, and the rain was very loud on the roof. We were all wet. Ben laughed. For dessert, the waitress brought sliced mango. After lunch, the sky was clear, and we walked on the beach for one hour. We found small shells in the sand, and Ben put one in his pocket.

On a Saturday, the Explorers went by bus to a market by the river. Teacher Kim gave each Explorer a name card for the neck as identification. The driver put our luggage under the bus. Mia kept her camera in her hands, and Leo kept his water bottle in a small bag. The bus left at seven o'clock, and the ride took one hour. The sky was blue all day, and there was no storm. It was a very sunny day. Mia counted us twice.

We ate lunch at a small restaurant at the market, and a waitress brought us noodles. For dessert, she brought a plate of fried bananas. A cook fried the bananas in oil in front of the restaurant. The oil was hot. It was very hot, so we watched from a safe place. Leo had two plates of noodles. After lunch, we walked along the river for one hour. Mia took many photos of the boats on the water. It was a long day, but nobody was tired.
Now think about the two trips. Were both days good? Which facts are the same, and which facts are different?
text.summary: Lily puts two short texts about day trips on the blog. Tom's class goes by train to a town by the sea, and the Explorers go by bus to a market by the river. The reader finds what is the same and what is different.
